dispute.claim_text: I cancelled my subscription on August 15 and received confirmation that there would be no further charges. I was charged again on September 15.

evidence.text: Merchant cancellation confirmation: 'Your subscription has been cancelled effective 2026-08-15. You will not be charged again.'
Recurring charge USD 29.99 on 2026-09-15, one month after the confirmed cancellation.
Cardholder to merchant after seeing the charge: 'I cancelled in August and have your confirmation; please reverse this.' No correction made.

labels.notes: Clear case. The disputed charge (ev_002, Sep 15) post-dates a confirmed cancellation effective Aug 15 (ev_001). The merchant cannot show the charge was a valid pre-cancellation or non-recurring charge.
